implementation_defect: The V698 classifier tests whether the first occurrence of each exact label is ordered. The locked ordered_contains evaluator instead advances a cursor and accepts any correctly ordered subsequence. Five inherited rows containing an early out-of-order occurrence plus a later valid sequence are therefore labeled as failures by the taxonomy even though the governing evaluator passes them.
attribution: V698 is not valid attribution evidence because its pass/order construct is not evaluator-identical. No identifier-copy bottleneck is certified by this result, even if the adapted counts appear unaffected.
authorized_successor_design: Exactly one evaluation-only repair may replace the first-occurrence test with the locked cursor-based ordered-subsequence semantics, bind the unchanged frozen suite and outputs, and rerun the taxonomy without new inference or changed thresholds.
claim_boundary: Failed taxonomy implementation only; no valid mechanism attribution, repaired host, ABI candidate, stable frontier, runtime pass, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4 certificate, or superiority claim.
